notes: Ontario Workforce Priority (OWP) stream, expression of interest scoring. Page published 2026-07-20; EOI portal opened 2026-08-04; all other OINP streams closed.
Earnings history factor updated on 2026-10-05 (OINP update of 2026-10-07): $80,000 or more in a year now gives 10 points.

factors.label: NOC TEER category of the job offer
NOC broad occupational category (first digit of the NOC)
Hourly wage of the job offer
Ontario work experience
options: Over 24 months full time in the job offer position
13 to 24 months full time in the job offer position
6 to 12 months full time in the job offer position
Under 6 months in the position, but over 24 months full time (or part-time equivalent) in Ontario
Under 6 months in the position, 13 to 24 months in Ontario
Under 6 months in the position, 6 to 12 months in Ontario
Less than 6 months in Ontario, or not working in Ontario

factors.label: Canadian earnings in a single year (CRA Notice of Assessment, last 5 years)
Legal status in Canada
options: No valid work or study permit

factors.label: Highest level of education (Canadian credential or ECA)
options: Doctorate, or degree in medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine or optometry
University certificate or diploma above a bachelor's
University certificate or diploma below a bachelor's
College, CEGEP or other non-university certificate or diploma
Apprenticeship or trades certificate or diploma
Less than college or trade certificate

factors.label: Canadian post-secondary credentials (at least one year full time)
Official language: lowest CLB across the four abilities (best of your English or French test)
Knowledge of official languages
options: 2 official languages (CLB 6+ in all four abilities in both tests)

factors.label: Region of the job offer's work location

regions.Northern Ontario: Muskoka, Haliburton, Nipissing, Parry Sound, Manitoulin, Sudbury, Greater Sudbury, Timiskaming, Cochrane, Algoma, Thunder Bay, Rainy River and Kenora
regions.Eastern Ontario: Frontenac, Hastings, Kawartha Lakes, Lanark, Leeds and Grenville, Lennox and Addington, Northumberland, Ottawa, Peterborough, Prescott and Russell, Prince Edward, Renfrew, and Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry
regions.Central Ontario outside the GTA: Dufferin, Grey, Simcoe, Waterloo and Wellington
regions.Southwestern Ontario: Brant, Bruce, Chatham-Kent, Elgin, Essex, Haldimand-Norfolk, Hamilton, Huron, Lambton, Middlesex, Niagara, Oxford and Perth
regions.Inside the GTA, except Toronto: the regional municipalities of Durham, Halton, Peel and York
